spanish: Y harás varas de maderas de acacia, y las revestirás de oro.

units.es: Y harás varas de maderas de acacia, y las revestirás de oro.

grammarChanges: Replaced untranslated transliteration "shitím" with the Spanish common noun "acacia" (H7848, common noun, must stay Spanish).
Added the preposition "de" before "oro" ("revestirás de oro"), required by Spanish for this verb-complement construction.
